name: Polopos (Spain)
description: Three vertical stripes in the proportions 1:2:1, the outer red and the central chequy of black and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Polopos (a tower between poplars on yellow with a flag).
history: Polopos adopted its arms officially on 18 October 1991 and its flag on 5 December 1998; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, formed of three vertical stripes in the proportions 1/4, 1/2 and 1/4, the outer red and the central chequy of 25 pieces, 13 black.

features.role: chequy of 25 pieces in the central stripe
